_about: Power measured during the local runs on 2026-10-05/06. GPU = AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT board power from the driver's PMLog sensor (scripts/gpu_power.py, column s73; 12 W median when idle, 277 W median when busy, 324 W max, which matches the card's 315 W board-power rating). CPU = Windows 'Energy Meter' RAPL package counter for the Ryzen 9 5900X, read as milliwatts. Neither includes the motherboard, RAM, SSD, fans or power-supply losses, so the wall draw is higher. Samples every 2 s. Summarised by scripts/summarize_power.py; the raw CSVs are not included.
